name: maludb-os-docker
description: Working on a MaluDB Business OS that runs as the dockerized install (maludb-os-docker: one systemd container `bos` on a MaluDB hosting VM, PostgreSQL and the MaluDB API on the host). Four skills: os-docker (the topology — what is in the image, on the volumes and on the host; the command book; troubleshooting), os-docker-new-app (build a new application in its own repository and install it into the container), os-docker-change-app (change an installed application: pull, migrate, reconcile, restart), os-docker-kernel (a kernel change is a new image). Ships bos-app.sh, the host-side wrapper around the kernel's installer that applies the container's topology fixes.
